subject: Score 29-class IM-023 checkpoints in the NMD holdout and forest5 evaluations
description: Tobias gave the go on 2026-11-06 for the IM-023 evaluation (items 1-3 of the plan) and its scoring decisions (PR #147). The existing code cannot score a 29-class model: ladder_holdout_eval.py is fixed to 28 classes and skips whole tiles holding class 28, has no per-tile matrices for the bootstrap and no direct checkpoint option; extract_forest_separability.py refuses num_classes != 28 and hard-codes the R4 checkpoint. Scope: those two evaluations plus their tests and eval jobs pinned to torch 2.10 and a source SHA. Not in scope: the NFI freeze amendment, LUCAS, scoring itself. Review: Codex or Tobias.
